source: G&V on ticket 823 (sockets for the PK4 kit items, the last open part of needs-planner): each kit item that shows on the rig names one vehicle-attach point outside those #809-#816 own and outside MODULE_ATTACH_POINTS. The Cache Crate has none: it is a placed world object drawn at its cell, held crates only a HUD count. Ticket 825 replaced the flat placeholders with Blender art: each socket names its asset (the kernel's slotItemAssetIdOf rule, vehicle-item-<id>), its parts and each part's draw order over the rig's. A part that moves carries a resting and an acting pose (a turn in radians about its pivot, counter-clockwise on screen, and a shift in metres); #850 sets the acting pose while the tool acts. A flask part shows from a held count (G&V: one flask per held flask up to the stack limit of 3); the shard shows only while the tongs act. Every part keeps inside the rig's bounds at every pose and behind the drawn drill tip (#789), which kitSocketLook.test.ts holds against the vehicle sidecar. Ticket 881 (G&V's re-pick on #850: no sharing) moves the three tools onto the kit-only points kit.blade, kit.grab and kit.mast, which no gear item takes (drill.hood, hull.arm.left and hull.roof.mid hold the containment, acid etcher and aether tether rigs); the flask stays on cab.gauge, the gauge cluster many items extend. The kit points stand where the tools hung until G&V's Blender pass (#883) moves them.

sockets.shows: A scree cowl over the drill collar, blades swept back; they flex outward when it shoves rubble.
A small rack by the cab with one flask per held flask, up to the stack limit of 3; a bottled flask glows faintly.
A gripper arm mirroring the mobility arm on hull.arm.right; it closes on a lifted spinecrystal, which rides in its jaws.
A folded brass vane on the roof that fans open while it rides a vent blast and folds shut afterwards.
